evals.expected_output: Skill should: (1) call get_stats + get_due_cards + list_decks, (2) read recent session logs for macro analytics, (3) check wiki index for stale pages, (4) present status with weekly trend, (5) wait for confirmation before starting

assertions.text: Calls get_stats, get_due_cards, and list_decks MCP tools
Reads recent logs for weekly accuracy trend
Checks wiki index for stale pages (>30 days, depth 1)
Presents card count, streak, and weekly trend
Waits for developer confirmation before starting study loop

evals.prompt: (During study session, developer gets a card wrong about event sourcing, which has lapsed 3 times this week and has no wiki page)
evals.expected_output: Skill should rate Again, show feedback with generation prompt, and at session end proactively recommend /study-walkthrough for the repeated lapse topic

assertions.text: Shows constructive feedback revealing the card back
At session end, detects repeated lapse pattern (3+ times)
Proactively recommends /study-walkthrough for the topic with no wiki page
Writes session log with lapses linked to wiki pages where they exist

evals.prompt: (Developer says 'show in Obsidian' during study session)

assertions.text: Checks the ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/.obsidian-cli.sock socket to see if connected
Launches with /opt/Obsidian/obsidian if not running (not snap)
Opens relevant page with obsidian open vault="study" file=<slug>
